title: DeterministicExplanationParams_AircraftWindowStressV1
description: Shape only. This describes the params object attached to a Bounded Visual Escalation RoutingDecision (quality/visual_escalation_routing_decision.schema.json) when action=PRODUCE and method=DETERMINISTIC_EXPLANATION. Template-specific semantic eligibility (does this grounding actually license this template for this scene) is a separate Python check in quality/grounded_deterministic_explanation.py -- this schema only rejects malformed shape (missing field, wrong type, unsupported enum value).

template_id.description: V1 supports exactly one template. No stub or TODO entries for future templates.

presentation.description: Escalation-level relation shape. Distinct from ComparisonSegmentDict.presentation (SPLIT_SCREEN/SEQUENTIAL) in the existing V2.1 contract, which this template reuses unchanged via comparison_segment_id.

evidence_source.description: V1 permits exactly one evidence source. VISION, SCRIPT_ONLY, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, LLM and similar are not permitted, and this enum is deliberately not widened for future extensibility (out of V1 scope).

grounding_provenance_ref.description: Reference into the existing trusted grounding/claim registry (e.g. a source URL or record key), not a freshly-computed value.

grounding_fingerprint.description: Stable identity derived only from grounding/claim/relation identity -- never raw narration, keyword, run id, timestamp, UUID, or output path.

comparison_segment_id.description: References a ComparisonSegmentDict emitted via the existing quality/visual_explanation_contract_v2.py contract -- no separate comparison schema is defined here.

param_signature.description: Attempt identity for the (method, param_signature) reuse-ban invariant in the escalation ledger.
